response.sql:
WITH race_avg AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.name AS raceName, AVG(cr.points) AS avgPoints, COUNT(*) AS resultCount
  FROM constructorResults cr
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
  WHERE cr.points > 1.0
  GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name
),
name_avg AS (
  SELECT raceName, AVG(avgPoints) AS nameAvg
  FROM race_avg
  GROUP BY raceName
)
SELECT ra.raceId, ra.raceName, ra.avgPoints, ra.resultCount, ra.avgPoints / na.nameAvg AS ratio
FROM race_avg ra
JOIN name_avg na ON na.raceName = ra.raceName
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The filter 'points > 1.0' applies to constructorResults.points, and rows with NULL points are excluded by the comparison.
Each race's average and count are computed over its constructorResults rows that pass the filter, so the count is the number of constructor results for that race with points > 1.0.
Races sharing a name are grouped by exact match on races.name across all years.
The ratio divides the unrounded per-race average by the unrounded race-name average. Ties in ratio have no specified order, so the top 10 may vary among tied rows.
